agent_runs_inline_check.name: agent_runs_inline_check
agent_runs_inline_check.value: "agent_runs"."execution_mode" <> 'inline_delegate' or ("agent_runs"."status" not in ('queued', 'waiting', 'waiting_tasks') and "agent_runs"."routine_run_id" is null and "agent_runs"."segment" = 0)

ai_apps_provider_connection_check.name: ai_apps_provider_connection_check
ai_apps_provider_connection_check.value: "ai_apps"."provider_connection_id" is null or ("ai_apps"."provider" = 'openai' and "ai_apps"."credential_mode" = 'org' and "ai_apps"."api_key_enc" is null)

ai_apps_base_url_check.name: ai_apps_base_url_check
ai_apps_base_url_check.value: "ai_apps"."provider" not in ('openai-compatible', 'hermes') or "ai_apps"."base_url" is not null

bot_pet_default_choice.name: bot_pet_default_choice
bot_pet_default_choice.value: ("bot_pet_defaults"."appearance" in ('moss', 'ember', 'off') and "bot_pet_defaults"."catalog_id" is null) or ("bot_pet_defaults"."appearance" = 'catalog' and "bot_pet_defaults"."catalog_id" is not null)

bot_pets_choice.name: bot_pets_choice
bot_pets_choice.value: ("bot_pets"."appearance" in ('moss', 'ember', 'custom') and "bot_pets"."catalog_id" is null) or ("bot_pets"."appearance" = 'catalog' and "bot_pets"."catalog_id" is not null)

conversations_bot_home_check.name: conversations_bot_home_check
conversations_bot_home_check.value: not "conversations"."is_bot_home" or (not "conversations"."is_group" and not "conversations"."archived" and "conversations"."source" = 'chat' and "conversations"."app_id" is null)

hermes_team_profile_mode_check.name: hermes_team_profile_mode_check
hermes_team_profile_mode_check.value: ("hermes_team_profiles"."mode" = 'member' and "hermes_team_profiles"."user_id" is not null and "hermes_team_profiles"."owner_key" = "hermes_team_profiles"."user_id") or ("hermes_team_profiles"."mode" = 'admin' and "hermes_team_profiles"."user_id" is null and "hermes_team_profiles"."owner_key" = 'team-admin:' || "hermes_team_profiles"."bot_id")

pet_catalog_sprite_hd_size.name: pet_catalog_sprite_hd_size
pet_catalog_sprite_hd_size.value: "pet_catalog"."sprite_hd" is null or octet_length("pet_catalog"."sprite_hd") between 1 and 12582912

remote_hermes_queue_check.name: remote_hermes_queue_check
remote_hermes_queue_check.value: ("remote_hermes_sessions"."queue_request_id" is null) = ("remote_hermes_sessions"."queue_status" is null) and ("remote_hermes_sessions"."queue_status" is null or "remote_hermes_sessions"."queue_status" in ('admitting','queued','uncertain'))
